answer: Persistent Query Relay. Each identity must answer randomized low-latency queries routed through a gale of live traffic, sustaining accuracy above a threshold for thirty days before gaining write access. An inlet of new identities is throttled by per-identity attention budgets: forged accounts fail query continuity. A bridge between read and write tiers opens only after continuous verified responsiveness. Attacker cost: sustained compute and monitoring per fake identity, roughly 40 hours of real-time upkeep monthly, scaling linearly.
